name: @absolutejs/logs
description: Structured log primitive for the AbsoluteJS substrate. Levels, child loggers, sinks (console-JSON, console-pretty, memory, rotating file), optional secret redaction via @absolutejs/secrets, optional trace-id correlation via @absolutejs/telemetry. Metrics surface for @absolutejs/metrics.
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/manifest.ts --outdir dist --sourcemap --target=bun && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && absolute-manifest emit
scripts.check:package: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test
scripts.release: bun run format && bun run check:package && bun publish
